SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, MIN(calendar_date) AS d0, MAX(calendar_date) AS d1, COUNT(*) AS days, SUM(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trading_days, MAX(weeks_in_fiscal_year) AS wiy
FROM dim_date
WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id = 900 THEN n.net_sales END) AS web_sales,
           COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT w.*, c.ctrl_net, w.net_sales - c.ctrl_net AS gap FROM weekly w JOIN ctrl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY 2, 1

SELECT 'sales_dup_id' AS chk, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS v FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_dup_receipt_line', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL SELECT 'return_dup_id', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_dup_order', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_lines_without_order', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order w WHERE w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id) AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL SELECT 'web_sales_lines_store900_in_range', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING (store_key) WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_web_order w WHERE w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_store_or_product_join_loss', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_key=f.store_key) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_product p WHERE p.product_key=f.product_key))
UNION ALL SELECT 'return_join_loss', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line f WHERE f.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05' AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_key=f.store_key) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_product p WHERE p.product_key=f.product_key))
UNION ALL SELECT 'staff_lines', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE staff_purchase_flag AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS ids, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
         COUNT(DISTINCT net_amount) AS amts, COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) AS prods, COUNT(DISTINCT quantity) AS qtys,
         MIN(sale_date) AS sd, MIN(store_key) AS sk
  FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
SELECT dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_week, COUNT(*) AS dup_keys, SUM(c) AS rows_in_dups, MAX(c) AS maxc, MAX(loads) AS maxloads, MIN(amts) AS min_amts, MAX(amts) AS max_amts, MAX(prods) AS maxprods, COUNT(DISTINCT sk) AS stores
FROM d JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date = d.sd GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'closure' AS kind, c.store_id, s.store_name, CAST(c.closure_type AS VARCHAR) AS info, c.closure_start_date AS d0, c.closure_end_date AS d1
FROM ref_store_closure c JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=c.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE (c.closure_start_date <= DATE '2025-06-22' AND c.closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-26') OR (c.closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-06-28' AND c.closure_end_date >= DATE '2026-06-01')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'open/close', store_id, store_name, format, open_date, close_date FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND ((open_date >= DATE '2024-05-01') OR close_date IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY 1, 6, 2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = r.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND s.store_id IN (125,129)
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3,2,1

    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r

SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
